subject: Failed payment & VAT credit: reconciliation and acquirer follow-up
messages:
From: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@olivecorp.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing@olivetech.co
Date: 2026-11-15T08:32:00-05:00
Subject: Failed payment for Oct invoice + VAT discrepancy

Hi Soojin,

We noticed the October invoice (attached) was attempted on 2026-11-01 and declined by the acquirer with a soft-decline code. The invoice also lists VAT that appears duplicated on our side (internal tax team flagged it). Can you confirm whether Redwood issued a VAT credit or whether this is something on our reconciliation?

Attached: olive-invoice-2026-10-31.pdf

We need to get this resolved before our month-end closing on 2026-11-20. Please advise the quickest path — split payment, retry, or credit?

Thanks,
Mark Jensen
CFO, OliveTech Systems

--
OliveTech Systems | 1-844-555-0198
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@olivecorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:04:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Failed payment for Oct invoice + VAT discrepancy

Mark — thanks for flagging and for the invoice. I'm looping in Ben (collections) and Naomi (tax) to coordinate. Quick summary from our side: the charge attempt hit an acquirer-level soft-decline (3DS fallback) and Stripe returned a 402/soft_decline code. We haven't issued a VAT credit yet — Naomi, can you confirm whether a credit is appropriate or whether Redwood should split the VAT line before retrying?

Ben: can you open an immediate retry path with the acquirer (we can try a small test charge first) and capture the acquirer decline log for compliance? If retry fails, Olive has asked about a VAT credit — Naomi will advise.

Next steps: 1) Ben to attempt acquirer re-route / test charge and share logs. 2) Naomi to advise on VAT credit vs invoice correction. 3) If credit needed, I will prepare a draft credit note and DocuSign link for Mark to sign.

Sooj

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@olivecorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Failed payment for Oct invoice + VAT discrepancy

Mark / Soojin — I opened a ticket with Stripe and attempted a routed retry through an alternate acquirer on 2026-11-15 13:10 UTC. Attached is the acquirer-decline-log-olivetech.eml (redacted PAN). Stripe ticket: ST-802341. Outcome: 1) test $1 auth succeeded using fallback routing; 2) full-invoice retry failed with a 3DS/issuer soft-decline once we attempted the full amount.

Recommendation: two parallel actions so we don't block your close: (A) If Olive's tax team prefers, issue a VAT credit for the duplicate line to reconcile books now while we keep collection attempts queued. (B) For card collectability, ask customer to re-enter card via the hosted update flow (we can send a one-click secure update link).

Action items: 
- Naomi: VAT advice to confirm whether we should issue the credit or modify the invoice.
- Mark: if you approve a VAT credit, Soojin will prepare the draft credit note and DocuSign.

Attachments: acquirer-decline-log-olivetech.eml

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@olivecorp.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T14:12:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Failed payment for Oct invoice + VAT discrepancy

Hi all — I reviewed the invoice and Olive's file. The VAT line appears to have been applied both on the invoice and again in Olive's payments reconciliation import, which means their accounting team likely double-posted. From Redwood's tax perspective, a VAT credit is acceptable if Olive needs to clear the period immediately; tax jurisdiction (IRL) requires a credit note referencing the original invoice. I attached a draft VAT credit note for Olive to sign — it mirrors the invoice number and reduces the VAT line only.

If Olive prefers to keep the invoice unchanged and retry collection, we can continue pursuing the card update workflow — Kar thik, please provide the secure update link and Stripe ticket reference for Mark.

Draft attached: vat-credit-draft-olive.docx
DocuSign draft will be live once we get Mark's approval: https://www.docusign.com/link/abcd-olive-vat-credit

Naomi Feldman
Tax & Compliance, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
